description: Negation and power canonicalize to `-` and `^` (RFC §5.4.7). The three input spellings of negation, unary `-`, binary `-` with a literal zero minuend, and the deprecated `neg` (esm-spec §4.2 "Deprecated ops"), all canonicalize to the unary `-` node; a double negation in mixed spellings collapses; a negated float literal becomes the negative literal; the deprecated `pow` canonicalizes to `^`. The canonical form never contains `neg` or `pow`.
